div.head: Swer 3.4
div.ab: 7 swa ic orf hæbbe, swa hit of minum agnum ðiggum com, 7 swa hit on folcriht min agen æhte is 7 min infoster.
Et sic pecus habeo, sicut de meo proprio uenit, et sicut in iure publico meum intus genitum et educatum est.
7 swa ic orf hæbbe, swa hit of minum agnum ðingum com, 7 swa hit on folcriht min agen æht is 7 min infoster.
[Alternatively:] And so I [do] have cattle which are my assets and which I bred myself with full legal right.
Beziehungsweise: só hab ich Vieh, wie es aus meinen eigenen Vermögensbeständen erwachsen ist, und wie es gemeinrechtlich mein Eigengut und meine heimische Aufzucht ist.
Or: I have the cattle just as it came from my own possessions, and as by folk-right it is my own property and home-bred.
div.note: B's ‘ðiggum’ (so) and ‘æhte’ are Middle English forms. Liebermann compares II As 9.
